english.title: Gross indecency between man aged over 21 years and boy under 16 years
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a man of or over the age of 21, committed an act of gross indecency with **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a man under the age of 16, namely of the age of **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13 of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
man of/over 21 years
committed gross indecency
with male under 16 years

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for prosecution of indecency between males where at least one is under the age of 16.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H2312 and H2310 where the offender is aged 16 to 20 - maximum two years imprisonment.
(iii) As amended by the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2000.
(iv) This offence is included in Schedule 1 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(v) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
